run_generation_cli: run the fairseq generate CLI to translate pre-processed data with a trained model
run_main_function: run the main generation function with a DictConfig to produce translations from a model checkpoint
run_internal_main: run the internal _main function to load models, iterate batches, and output hypotheses with scores
review_get_symbols_to_strip: review the get_symbols_to_strip_from_output function that returns symbols to strip from generator output
review_cli_main: review the cli_main function that builds the argument parser and calls main for generation
